headline: Wardens Secure Callahan's Passage as Clashes Rake Palantine and Mooring
war_summary: Warden forces have consolidated complete control over Callahan's Passage, securing all ten strategic bases following three fresh exchanges across The Crumbling Passage and Crumbling Post. Palantine Berm remains the fiercest flashpoint on the map, logging four more transitions in the past two hours amidst relentless fighting at Leiri Hermanni and Windburn Landing, leaving Wardens clinging to a six-to-one advantage. In Mooring County, ground combat has reached fever pitch, devouring over seventeen hundred casualties in two hours as battle lines grind against the lone Colonial bastion at The Wind Hills. Meanwhile, the northern front at Kuura Strand has lapsed into sudden silence following earlier Warden consolidation, showing zero casualties over the latest two hours. Stlican Shelf and Nevish Line have likewise seen base transfers pause over the last two hours, though Nevish Line remains evenly partitioned four to four with steady bloodshed. In Weathered Expanse, territory holds static despite ongoing skirmishing, marking a broader shift toward grueling trench attrition across central sectors.
